summary: Implemented Graph.cbd(resource) in rdflib/graph.py: returns a new Graph of triples whose subject is the resource, recursively following blank-node objects with cycle protection and leaving the source graph unchanged. Added test/test_graph_cbd.py (7 cases) and a Concise Bounded Description section in docs/utilities.rst. Tests were not run, per instructions. Nothing committed. Left out the black requirement (struck through in the spec) and the W3C reification extension; the result does not copy namespace bindings.
